messages.subject: Predictions from model averaging
parts:
Hi all,
I use the occu function in unmarked and I run several models Then, I
use model averaging to know wich covariates affect my parameters
Finally, I want to have model-averaged predictions but predict
function doesn't work when I run it. I based my script on that of
Fiske I.J. and Chandler R.B. 2011 (list of models created by fitList,
then predict(fitList)). I obtain the following error message: "cannot
coerce class 'structure("unmarkedFrameOccu", package = "unmarked")'
into a data.frame"
As anybody a solution? Thanks in adavance,

Aude C.

messages.author: c3fba61596f3d3b8
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Predictions from model averaging
parts:
Hi all,
Thanks to Andy Royle, here is the solution to the problem of predictions from model averaging.
You have to define a new data file:
newData1 <- data.frame(cbind(obs.covs,site.covs))
This puts everything in a matrix before coercing into a data.frame. When you use de function predict(), you have to feed it the dataframe so defined.
Aude C.
